editorial_note: Practice-based register, separate from published literature. Observations are not independently audited; do not present them as measured outcomes.

cases.name: AIFS × Sarreya — Olympism365 Tech365
cases.status: Completed pilot; field findings reported internally
cases.observations: Community governance, relational off-ramping, WhatsApp-based signal capture, local stewardship, financial exclusion and transaction risk.
cases.research_question: How can community-authorized evidence and local financial relationships support accountable access to capital?
cases.limitations: Field report not independently audited. Avoid implying that faster payment alone validates community trust.
cases.publication_status: working draft; partner and safeguarding review required before public promotion
cases.evidence_basis: Internal project draft, UNICEF writing sample, CTI Thesis V2.1; no independent audit

cases.name: SportFi — Women Win / AIFS
cases.observations: Explores community-generated signals, steward attestations and yield-funded community distributions.
cases.research_question: Can validated community activity improve funder confidence and support more responsive allocation decisions?
cases.limitations: No demonstrated change in funder allocation decisions or generalizable impact claims yet.

cases.name: Ayni Skate Project
cases.observations: Second context for steward attestations and participation signals.
cases.research_question: Are trust processes portable across contexts without imposing Sarreya's governance or cultural assumptions?
cases.limitations: Pilot research question, not a completed evaluation.

cases.name: Hoops Sagrado
cases.observations: Potential QR participation records and steward confirmation in community basketball.
cases.research_question: Can low-friction signals produce useful evidence without intrusive identity requirements?
cases.limitations: Proposed experiment only; no outcomes claimed.
